create_sampler_for_mcmc: create a Sampler with a BaseInference kernel and initial World to generate MCMC samples
run_sampler_send_iteration: run a single MCMC sampling iteration by calling send on the Sampler to propose and accept worlds
build_sampler_with_adaptation: build a Sampler with num_adaptive_samples to enable proposer adaptation during the burn-in phase
review_sampler_proposal_logic: review the Sampler send method to understand MH ratio acceptance and Cholesky error handling
test_sampler_stop_iteration: test the Sampler to verify it raises StopIteration after num_samples iterations are exhausted
